# js-dos 8.3.20

`js-dos.js`, `js-dos.css` and `emulators/` are the `dist/` build from the `js-dos` npm
package, version 8.3.20, copied unmodified, minus source maps, type declarations and
the DOSBox-X build. js-dos is GPL-2.0 licensed (per its package.json), as is the DOSBox
it compiles to WebAssembly; source, license and authors: https://github.com/caiiiycuk/js-dos

Used by archived DOS games that have a player page, e.g.
`sites/damascus-online.com/stonethrowers/game.html`.
